Britain left the EU's single market in January 2021. This body of work tracks
what actually happened to UK trade and firm performance in the years since —
using firm-level and product-level data rather than the pre-referendum
forecasts that dominated the public debate.

**Services exports from the UK to Ireland fell sharply relative to a
synthetic control once the Trade and Cooperation Agreement took effect** —
one of the clearest firm-level signals yet that Brexit's costs have fallen
disproportionately on services, not just goods.
